meta.title: Sustainability | Ultranex DTF
meta.description: Ultranex is committed to eco-friendly manufacturing through water-based coatings, rigorous quality control, employee well-being, and responsible energy management.

hero.headline: Sustainability
hero.tagline: With an unwavering commitment to innovation, we have delved deep into the realms of research and development to build a cleaner, more responsible manufacturing process.

pillars.title: Water Based Coatings
pillars.body: We developed eco-friendly water-based coating technology as a responsible alternative to traditional solvent-based coatings. Conventional coatings release harmful chemicals that pose a significant threat to the delicate ecological balance. Our water-based approach prioritizes environmental responsibility while delivering the same high performance. Choosing Ultranex means not only choosing quality and efficiency but also contributing to a cleaner and healthier planet.

pillars.title: No Rework Policy
pillars.body: Ultranex holds ISO 9001:2015 certification and implements rigorous quality control at every stage. Our no-rework policy reflects our confidence in product quality — we get it right the first time.
points: Incoming material checks at every production run
Comprehensive quality assurance plans and SOPs
In-house laboratory testing of all production lots
Assessment of printing processes and wash stability
Full traceability — every product traced back to its raw material origins via unique lot numbers

pillars.title: Better Facilities for People
pillars.body: Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. We maintain world-class facilities that provide safe, comfortable, and inspiring work environments. High hygiene and health and safety standards are non-negotiable. Founder Bhavesh Shah believes that precision and excellence begin with a team that feels cared for — we are a family that fosters the growth of every individual.

pillars.title: Energy Management
pillars.body: We are committed to environmentally responsible manufacturing across every dimension of our operations.
points: Continuous quality improvements and right-first-time policies to reduce waste
Active monitoring of utilities consumption for ongoing optimisation
Regeneration of waste and scrap material as production input

certifications.title: OEKO-TEX Standard 100
certifications.desc: Free from harmful substances and chemicals

cta.headline: Built for Quality. Built for the Planet.
